principal_activity: OVERVIEW Pixel Fusion Ltd is a Lincolnshire-based custom software development and technology consultancy. The company designs, builds and supports bespoke software, scalable cloud solutions, data automation and integration, business intelligence and Microsoft Power Platform applications. It serves UK and international organisations across the commercial, public and not-for-profit sectors, helping clients improve operations and develop secure, reliable and scalable digital systems. The business brings together software development, data engineering, architecture, delivery and quality assurance within one accountable UK-based team. It works collaboratively with clients from initial discovery and design through development, deployment and ongoing support, building long-term relationships around business-critical systems and data. Planned growth The year represented the next stage of the company's planned growth strategy. The directors invested in people, delivery capability, governance, quality assurance, information security and structured routes to market with the objective of building a scalable software and data-engineering business able to serve larger and more complex clients. The strategy produced tangible progress. The average number of employees increased to 10, compared with 6 in the year ended 31 March 2025. By the date of this report, the wider team comprised 16 directly employed staff and 11 associate consultants, providing materially greater delivery capacity while retaining flexibility over the mix of permanent and specialist resource. Turnover increased by approximately 95% and gross profit by approximately 103% year on year. The company continued to grow profits while making significant investments in people, technology, assurance, training, governance and professional support, building the capacity and organisational maturity needed to deliver larger engagements and support continued growth. INVESTMENT IN CAPABILITY AND MATURITY The enlarged team provides capability across data engineering, software development, Microsoft Power Platform, analytics, accessibility, delivery management and quality assurance. This is supported by documented in-house methodologies covering architecture, software development, data engineering, machine-learning operations, quality assurance and intellectual-property transfer, making delivery more repeatable, controlled and auditable. During the year the company achieved Cyber Essentials Plus certification in October 2025 and ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certification in January 2026. The ISO certifications are independently audited and UKAS-accredited. They formalise the company's controls over quality management and information security and strengthen its ability to compete for complex and regulated work across sectors. The control environment is reinforced by defined responsibility for architecture, delivery and quality and by an exclusively UK-based workforce. All employees have been screened in accordance with BS 7858. A number of the company's software engineers have also completed Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks and hold Security Check (SC) clearance, while the current directors are security-cleared. The technical team maintains current certifications across Microsoft Power Platform and associated data technologies. EVIDENCE OF DELIVERY AND COMMERCIAL PROGRESS The company's investment in assurance and delivery capability is translating into real-world results across a diversified client base. At the date of this report, the company was delivering major ongoing contracts for UK and global businesses operating in logistics, supply-chain management and financial-services delivery. It also maintained an extensive portfolio of contracted delivery for not-for-profit organisations. Public-sector delivery remains an important part of this broader portfolio and an additional route to market. At the date of this report, the company held a position on Crown Commercial Service G-Cloud 15, alongside places on a number of other public-sector frameworks and purchasing systems. It continued to secure and deliver engagements won through open competition. STRENGTHENING LEADERSHIP AND FINANCIAL CAPACITY The board was strengthened by the appointment of Richard Rowell as Strategy and Commercial Director in February 2026. Richard brings experience across finance, professional services and software development, strengthening the board's strategic, commercial, financial and governance capability as the business continues to grow. The company further strengthened its funding position through additional investment and new lines of credit. This increased financial headroom supports continued growth and expansion, including recruitment, bid activity and the working-capital requirements of larger engagements. The directors will deploy this capacity carefully, aligned with secured work, credible pipeline opportunities and close cash-flow management. POSITION AT THE DATE OF THIS REPORT AND OUTLOOK The directors believe the company's progression demonstrates increasing strength and maturity. Planned investment in people, governance, accreditation and routes to market has translated into a larger delivery team, stronger financial capacity and a balanced portfolio of commercial, public and not-for-profit work. This provides a sound platform for continued, sustainable growth. The directors will continue to pursue opportunities for expansion while maintaining disciplined recruitment, cash management, delivery oversight and the quality and information-security standards on which the company's developing market position depends.
